✦ Heads up · total.py rounds 4.425 down
  to 4.42 because it sums the prices as
  binary floats.

  Floats cannot store most prices
  exactly
  2.675 is stored as 2.67499999..., so
  round(2.675, 2) gives 2.67, and the
  sum lands just under 4.425.
  Use decimal.Decimal(row["price"]) and
  pick the rounding rule on purpose.

  1: Understood
  2: Chat in main session
  0: Dismiss
